title: Common Pitfalls & How to Avoid Them
use_cases: Use when transitioning between different character perspectives to ensure clarity
Implement when auditing a manuscript for tense consistency across scenes
Configure when establishing boundaries for character knowledge in limited narration
Use when structuring chapter breaks to signal shifts in setting or narrator
content:
| Pitfall | Explanation | Remedy | Abrupt Switches | Sudden change without cue. | Use transitional sentences or chapter breaks. | Mixed Tenses | Switching tense mid‑POV. | Stick to one tense per POV; plan ahead. | Unclear Narrator Identity | Reader unsure who is speaking. | Introduce narrator explicitly at start of each shift. | Over‑Omniscience in Limited POV | Too much information leaks. | Keep focus on the chosen character’s knowledge. |
